description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across various layers. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer,' and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Ratio,' and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. A blue dashed line represents the 'sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003,' which begins at approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and remains relatively constant at around 0.01 across all layers up to layer 23. An orange dotted line represents the 'sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126,' starting at 0.79 at layer 0 and decreasing to 0.12 at layer 5, then continuing to decrease to 0.06 at layer 23. A green dash-dot line represents the 'sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080,' beginning at 0.79 at layer 0 and decreasing to 0.08 at layer 5, then decreasing further to 0.03 at layer 23.
caption_used: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across various layers. The x-axis is labeled 'Layer,' and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled 'Sparsity Ratio,' and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, starts at a ratio of approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and remains constant throughout. The green dash-dot line, representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, begins at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreases exponentially, reaching 0.05 at layer 5 and stabilizing near 0.0 from layer 10 onward. The orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, shows a similar pattern to the green line, beginning at about 0.8 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.2 by layer 10, with a small spike after layer 20. Notably, the sparsity ratio after the average gate consistently exceeds the sparsity ratio after the gate across all layers.
